integrity: The all-n proof is analytic. Finite exact-rational checks are supplementary and are not used as a substitute for the proof. Literature comparisons are limited to the inspected sources and searches listed in AUDIT.json.
scientific_limitations: The exact constant is proved only for one fermionic mode per copy and the retained two-copy marginal.
No sharp claim is made for more retained copies, larger local mode number, non-Gaussian marginals, or alternative fermionic exchangeability notions.
The covariance suppression constant itself is not new; the new statement is the sharp state-level optimization under that covariance geometry.
title: Sharp one-mode two-copy fermionic Gaussian de Finetti constant
